scope: Physical selected prefixes and original candidate pools for raw and DSL source-multi and DSL capped-material continuations
implementation: SourceChoicePin.resolve_ref rebases a physical source under its original stable carrier.
Raw and DSL source-multi prefixes retain original pins; moved prefixes cannot count toward the required floor.
SourceMultiState target_carrier_identity follows the restricted physical carrier through field compaction.
MultiPickState source_pool captures the complete originally filtered material pool and rebuilds live positions without reoffering selected physical cards.
Material pool refresh preserves distinct-by and named-role feasibility using only surviving physical cards.
All DSL continuations remain cloneable data; no shared callbacks were introduced.
Named source-group controls dispatch owned physical rows, preserving original role legality and alias assertions.

failures: Raw prefix retained old carrier slot after compaction.
Moved DSL prefix incorrectly earned four memory.
A selected physical material reappeared after source compaction: two remaining rows instead of one.
Positional target restriction lost its physical carrier after compaction.
